pocket kitten

Privacy

Pocket Kitten collects nothing about you. There are no accounts, no ads and no tracking. Your kitten is kept on your own phone and we never see her.

What is kept on your phone

So that your kitten is there when you come back, the app keeps these on your device (phone, tablet or computer), and only there:

  • Her name, her needs, your friendship and her Moments.
  • Your choices: sound, her ribbon, how you look around the room.
  • The picture quality that suits your device, which the app works out by itself.
  • One photo of her for the frame over the fire, if you hang one. It is a picture of the game. The app never uses your camera.
  • A copy of the app itself, so it opens without signal.

None of this is sent to us or to anyone else.

What leaves your phone

Only what you send or save yourself. Share on a photo or a backup code hands it to the app you pick. Save photo puts the picture in your own files. Copy code puts the code on your clipboard. A backup code holds your kitten: her name, her Moments and your progress. Keep it like a key.

What we never ask for

Your name, email address, age, location, contacts, camera or microphone. The app has no cookies, no advertising and nothing that counts or follows visitors.

The website it comes from

Pocket Kitten is served by GitHub Pages. Each time the app opens with signal it asks that site for its files and for the latest version. Like every website, the host then sees the internet address of your device, and GitHub keeps that for security. We cannot see those records. GitHub’s privacy statement says how they handle it.

Children

Pocket Kitten is gentle enough for children, and it collects nothing from anyone, children included. There is nothing to buy and no way to talk to other players. The small print at the bottom of the app has a few links to the websites we credit.

Removing everything

Everything is on your device, so you are in charge of it. Clearing this website’s data in your browser’s settings removes your kitten and all of the above for good. On an iPhone, removing Pocket Kitten from the home screen does the same for the home-screen copy. Photos you saved and backup codes you copied stay where you put them. We hold no copy, so there is nothing for us to delete. If you want to keep her, copy a backup code first.

Changes

If Pocket Kitten ever starts to send anything from your phone, this page will say so first, in plain words.

Questions

A contact address will be here before Pocket Kitten is offered in any app store.
